# When To Go

> When To Go is an interactive world map and set of guides that show the best
> time of year to visit any country, by month. Each country gets a 0 to 100
> weather comfort rating per month, built from daytime heat, overnight chill,
> rainfall and tropical-storm risk, plus its high versus low travel season and
> any hazards like monsoon, typhoon or extreme heat.

## Pages

- [World map](https://gowhereandwhen.com/): pick a month, see where the weather is good across 202 countries.
- [Best time to visit, by country](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/): the full list of country guides.
- [Best time to visit Japan](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/japan/): The best time to visit Japan is spring, late March to May for cherry blossom, and November for autumn colour.
- [Best time to visit USA](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/usa/): May and September are the best all-round months to visit the USA, with mild weather across most regions.
- [Best time to visit Canada](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/canada/): The best time to visit Canada is summer, June to August, for warm days and long light, with September and October a quieter, golden alternative.

- [Best time to visit South Africa](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/south-africa/): The best time to visit South Africa depends on the trip: Cape Town and the coast shine in the summer, November to March, while safari in Kruger is best in the dry winter, May to September.

- [Best time to visit Malaysia](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/malaysia/): Malaysia is warm and humid year round, with the best weather set by which coast you visit.
- [Best time to visit Philippines](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/philippines/): The best time to visit the Philippines is the dry season, December to May, with sunny weather and calm seas for the islands and beaches.
- [Best time to visit Sri Lanka](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/sri-lanka/): The best time to visit Sri Lanka depends on the coast: the west and south, including Colombo and Galle, are best from December to March, while the east coast is best from May to September.
- [Best time to visit Cambodia](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/cambodia/): The best time to visit Cambodia is the cool, dry season from November to February, ideal for Angkor Wat and comfortable sightseeing.
- [Best time to visit Nepal](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/nepal/): The best time to visit Nepal is autumn, October to November, for clear Himalaya views and prime trekking, and spring, March to April, for the rhododendron bloom.

- [Best time to visit Denmark](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/denmark/): The best time to visit Denmark is summer, June to August, for the longest, mildest days, harbour swimming and outdoor life in Copenhagen.
- [Best time to visit Finland](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/finland/): The best time to visit Finland is summer, June to August, for the midnight sun, lakes and forests, or winter, December to March, for northern lights, husky safaris and Santa in Lapland.
- [Best time to visit Cuba](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/cuba/): The best time to visit Cuba is the dry season, November to April, with warm, sunny weather for Havana and the beaches.
- [Best time to visit Dominican Republic](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/dominican-republic/): The best time to visit the Dominican Republic is December to April, the drier, cooler season ideal for the beaches and resorts.
- [Best time to visit Chile](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/chile/): The best time to visit Chile is spring and autumn, September to November and March to May, for Santiago and the wine country, while Patagonia is a summer destination, December to March.
- [Best time to visit Kenya](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/kenya/): The best time to visit Kenya is the dry seasons, June to October and January to February, for prime safari and the Great Migration in the Masai Mara.
- [Best time to visit Tanzania](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/tanzania/): The best time to visit Tanzania is the dry season, June to October, for prime safari and Serengeti game viewing, with the wildebeest calving in January to February.
- [Best time to visit Maldives](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/maldives/): The best time to visit the Maldives is the dry season, December to April, with sunny skies, calm seas and excellent diving.
- [Best time to visit Fiji](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/fiji/): The best time to visit Fiji is the dry season, May to October, with sunny, cooler weather and calm seas for the islands and diving.
- [Best time to visit Taiwan](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/taiwan/): The best time to visit Taiwan is autumn, October to November, and spring, March to April, with mild, dry weather and clear skies.
- [Best time to visit Tuvalu](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/tuvalu/): The best time to visit Tuvalu is June to September, the drier trade-wind months, with calmer seas and the clearest water in Funafuti's lagoon.
- [Best time to visit Samoa](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/samoa/): The best time to visit Samoa is the dry season, May to October, with trade winds, far less rain and prime weather for beach fales and waterfalls.
- [Best time to visit Tonga](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/tonga/): The best time to visit Tonga is the dry season, May to October. July to October adds the humpback whales, the only place you can swim beside them.
- [Best time to visit French Polynesia](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/french-polynesia/): The best time to visit French Polynesia is the dry season, May to October, with mild trade winds and the clearest lagoons in Tahiti and Bora Bora.
- [Best time to visit Cook Islands](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/cook-islands/): The best time to visit the Cook Islands is the dry season. June to October is driest, and September to November adds warmth before the rains return.
- [Best time to visit Niue](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/niue/): The best time to visit Niue is the dry season, May to October, when humpback whales calve off the reef and the water is at its astonishing clearest.
- [Best time to visit Vanuatu](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/vanuatu/): The best time to visit Vanuatu is the dry season, May to October, for mild weather, clear diving and the surest access to the Mount Yasur volcano.
- [Best time to visit New Caledonia](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/new-caledonia/): The best time to visit New Caledonia is September to December, warm and at its driest, for the world's largest lagoon, Noumea and the Isle of Pines.
- [Best time to visit Solomon Islands](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/solomon-islands/): The best time to visit the Solomon Islands is June to September, the drier trade-wind season, with the calmest seas and clearest diving on the WWII wrecks.
- [Best time to visit Papua New Guinea](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/papua-new-guinea/): The best time to visit Papua New Guinea is the dry season, June to October, which also brings the great Highlands festivals at Mount Hagen and Goroka.
- [Best time to visit Palau](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/palau/): The best time to visit Palau is the drier season, December to April, for the calmest seas and peak visibility diving the Rock Islands and Blue Corner.
- [Best time to visit Micronesia](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/micronesia/): The best time to visit the Federated States of Micronesia is January to March, the least-wet window for Nan Madol, Chuuk Lagoon's wrecks and Yap's mantas.
- [Best time to visit Marshall Islands](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/marshall-islands/): The best time to visit the Marshall Islands is January to March, the driest trade-wind months, with calm lagoons for diving, fishing and atoll hopping.
- [Best time to visit Kiribati](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/kiribati/): The best time to visit Kiribati is roughly June to October, the drier trade-wind months on Tarawa, with no cyclone season at all on the equator.
- [Best time to visit Nauru](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/nauru/): The best time to visit Nauru is June to September, the driest months on the world's least-visited island nation, with no cyclones this close to the equator.
- [Best time to visit Guam](https://gowhereandwhen.com/country/guam/): The best time to visit Guam is the dry season, January to April, with reliable sun on Tumon Bay before the summer rains and typhoon season arrive.

## Notes

- Ratings use climate normals for one representative hub city per country, so coastal versus inland and north versus south will vary.
- This is a planning guide based on long-run averages, not a forecast.
